launches.title: Understood Care: AI Powered Patient Advocacy
launches.tagline: Delivering high quality, Medicare covered patient advocacy to the 68 million Medicare patients in the US.
launches.body:
### **What is Understood Care?**

[Understood Care](https://understoodcare.com/) is a virtual patient advocacy platform for patients with Medicare.  

Advocates are administrative assistants with healthcare expertise that unblock access to care for patients. Advocates can help patients find transportation, schedule appointments, apply for financial aid and much more. We use AI to help advocates deliver superior advocacy at scale. 

Patient advocacy became a new Medicare covered benefit in 2024. Most Understood Care patients pay $0 out of pocket.  

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93210&key=user_uploads/1753723/334db23e-a29e-4633-bfb1-57c94259e184)

### **The Problem**

The American healthcare system is notoriously complex. 72% of insured adults lack confidence in managing their health insurance and benefits.

For the **68 million Medicare beneficiaries,** these challenges are even greater. Barriers in technology, finances, and health literacy often keep Medicare patients from accessing care, driving worse health outcomes and higher costs to the system.

The number of patients experiencing this problem is only growing. By 2030, the number of Medicare beneficiaries is projected to reach 80 million. 

### **How does Understood Care work?**

1️⃣ Patient signs up on website or by calling in.

2️⃣ We check the patient’s insurance eligibility and complete a patient intake with our clinical team.

3️⃣ We get the patient matched with the advocate that best fits their needs.

4️⃣ The advocate uses Understood Care’s clinical expertise and AI tools to resolve each patient’s unique care needs.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeu763mRuapSrYOVLGo_5FCjlG0c_9dUyncnOXfW1wNKvcmZr9Y51pfCvcFMcNAfe12p3dyfLAXTWQH9PkJ-IHExh3SWaC7KPoplpAYsE_YRTVWE2TUkHG3YlUAMB0vLHLO7YptTw?key=MP2f1P5qm-uzbzkuGXiGIg)

Examples of problems we’ve helped patients tackle:

⚠️ **Problem:** Patient could no longer drive to his appointments.

✅ **Solution:** We set the patient up with free county medical transportation. 

⚠️ **Problem:** The patient did not have money to afford proper food.

✅ **Solution:** We signed the patient up for a program that delivers free nutritious meals to low income seniors. 

⚠️ **Problem:** Patient received a new diagnosis and was overwhelmed.

✅ **Solution:** We helped the patient go over the doctor’s instructions and scheduled appointments with in network specialists.

### **Milestones**

⭐ We helped our first patient in April and are currently supporting 300+ patients.

⭐ Active in 40 states.

⭐ Able to accept Medicare, UHC, Humana and Aetna (top 3 Medicare Advantage plans).

### **Team**

Understood Care is built by a team fluent in AI, healthcare operations, and clinical care. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93210&key=user_uploads/1753723/e2f97acd-32f9-42d0-a5e0-5236e7ff6646)

[Sam](https://www.linkedin.com/in/samanthawu/) (CEO) was an operator at several high growth healthcare tech startups including Finni, SiteRx, and Cedar. Ex-Carlyle, ex-Evercore. 

[Kevin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kevin-bailey-2951b0162/) (CTO) was a previous 2x founder (1x in browser tech, 1x in enterprise VDI). Ex- Uber/Postmates.

[Dr. Adam Bonder ](https://www.linkedin.com/in/adam-j-bonder-md-mba-83b7a254/)(Medical Director) was previously the Medical Director at a VC backed behavioral health practice and is a actively practicing ER doc.

### **Asks**

✔️ Please share [our website ](https://understoodcare.com/)with friends or family that could benefit from our services. 

✔️ Please help us spread the word to other healthcare and community organizations - we accept [referrals](https://understoodcare.com/refer) through our website.

✔️ Give us a follow on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/understood-care) and [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/understoodcare).

launches.title: 🍃 Ply Health: Get providers in network faster
launches.tagline: We use AI to get behavioral health providers in network, so they can start billing twice as fast.
launches.body:
### tl;dr

Providers need to get in network with insurance companies, but the process is time-consuming and an administrative headache. We ingest provider information and use AI to automate submissions, saving providers months of waiting.

### ❌ The Problem

Being in network with a health insurer is critical for both patients and providers:

* For patients, seeing in network providers means dramatically lower healthcare costs. This informs which providers they choose and whether they can even afford to visit one.
* For providers, being in network means a bigger pool of potential patients. It also simplifies billing and reimbursement.

However, the process of getting a provider in network is highly manual and fragmented. There are approximately **1,400** payers in the US, each with their own enrollment process. Some of these processes involve painstakingly filling out 50+ page forms.

On top of burning hours of administrator time, delays are costly. A single incorrect field can push back cases by months. With providers billing $3,000/week, this costs healthcare practices **tens of thousands of dollars per provider**.

### ⭐ Our Solution

We provide standardized questionnaires to collect all required provider information and documents. Our customers are then able to request a new network enrollment in just a few clicks instead of spending hours navigating insurance websites to find the correct forms.

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcMXSY2xKtBcO4T1bMrr_zU44eg-Shd1X_9JaM3loR6QgKdsuVHkOByIopdf09h2mBDLkIN563IS6LnLwhLnwQrvpoJKiG3qxYI6sAyIFgs6VCP0o-Eq-Y4niQc9koDRqzATtjI71T-pZFVZCBWP1jRbrE?key=qI7khypm2_NJ8SwqwOuqbw)

On the backend, we’re automating each part of the enrollment process. We also have an experienced ops team as humans-in-the-loop to make sure everything is processed correctly. This ensures that enrollments are completed quickly and accurately, our customers’ two most important KPIs.

Our product is currently optimized for behavioral health providers. We are working quickly to expand into other specialties. 

### 📈 Results with Ply

We are currently working with practices such as Finni Health, Legion Health, Anna Autism Care, Shasta Health, and Birches Health. 

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfVVy8FtGG_dzB_Ok3lF30vt2HSlARjOP6gSLJxnRd52W9JDim6lUK79dMrMHCBKQrOW21-FgFVzw7PUXMc5dw2zQqJG6_dRPQ9l-0d1QQl8c4IN-lLTWQeuxSPjZweagiSJcKRq-hjVWkkud8rI_oBCU2k?key=qI7khypm2_NJ8SwqwOuqbw)

For our customers, we’re getting in network **2x - 3x** **faster** compared to alternative solutions, helping them earn additional **hundreds of thousands of dollars** in billing revenue.

### 🧑‍💻 The team

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81329&key=user_uploads/1753723/1187d057-d8f6-4f2d-9472-44b209b86df4)

_We’ve been friends for over 15 years but don't actually have pictures together because we’re both camera shy_

**Sam** started her career in finance (M&A IB, then large cap PE) before realizing that she was meant to be a startup operator. She discovered the pain point of contracting and credentialing first hand when she was running BizOps at Finni Health. 

**David** is a pre-med turned software engineer with a specialty in building scalable backend systems at Meta and Snap. 

## 🙏 The ask

If you’re a behavioral health practice or are friends with one, we’d love to chat! Please reach out at [hello@plyhealth.com](mailto:hello@plyhealth.com) or book a demo on our [website](https://www.plyhealth.com/). 

If you’re at a behavioral health insurance payer, or are friends with one, we’d love to chat about potential partnerships. Please reach out at [hello@plyhealth.com](mailto:hello@plyhealth.com).

If nothing else, we’d appreciate sharing our launch and following us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/plyhealth)!

launches.body:
Hey YC! We’re Dominik, Tim, and Julius from [Dodo](https://dodo.health).

Dominik and Julius grew up together, and we have known each other for 15 years. We were all in grad school together and just moved up from Stanford.

# **TL;DR: Dodo handles front- and back-office tasks for specialty clinic end-to-end**

* Our AI agents answer calls, send medical records, and refill prescriptions—fully autonomously, with no human in the loop
* We are starting with veterinary clinics, and are expanding to dental and physical therapy
* Same-day cancellations trigger automatic outbound calls, filling availabilities on short notice
* This means: No more hold music, phone trees (”press 1 for x”), or voicemail beeps (sorry if you like listening to jingles for minutes on end 🎶)

### **How you can help ❤️**

* Know someone **who owns a specialty clinic, independently or through a larger corporate/PE?** We would be grateful for an introduction!
* **Reach out **[**founders@dodo.health**](https://mailto:founders@dodo.health)** or book time on our **[**calendar**](https://dodo.cal.com)**.**

### **Problem: Clinics can’t keep up with their admin work**

* **🫥 Understaffed**: Clinics face labor shortages for administrative tasks, with staff feeling burned out due to long hours and inefficient workflows.
* **🚆 Undertrained**: One in three medical receptionists leaves their job each year
* **☎️ Phone-based**: Clinics handle up to 80% of their communication over the phone

# **TL;DR**

Hospitals use complex, unintuitive scheduling software **that still requires full-time administrators** to manage it. Entire teams spend **hours juggling shifts, fixing errors, and handling last-minute changes** — leading to inefficiencies, staff dissatisfaction, and **billions in lost productivity and resources.**

**YouShift replaces manual work with AI-powered automation** that creates **fair, efficient, and compliant schedules.**

# **The Problem: Shift scheduling is a mess**

Most hospitals rely on **manual scheduling processes and fragmented, unintuitive software** platforms that don't integrate. Schedulers and physicians spend hours adjusting shifts and then manually transferring data between disconnected systems, wasting time, increasing errors, and creating inefficiencies.

Bad scheduling impacts **hospital efficiency, staff well-being, and patient care** — a problem that healthcare simply can't afford.

# **The Solution: AI scheduling that works for everyone**

Unlike traditional scheduling tools, **we don’t just digitize spreadsheets — we replace them with an intelligent system that optimizes scheduling** for both staff and hospitals.

<https://youtu.be/GgKVlw3L-GA>

We're not stopping at scheduling. Our vision is to build the **all-in-one healthcare workforce management system** — think **Rippling for healthcare**. This includes:

* Payroll & time tracking
* Credentialing & compliance
* Hiring, staffing analytics & workforce optimization

We’ve seen this problem firsthand — we all grew up seeing **doctors in our family** who have struggled with chaotic schedules, last-minute changes, and burnout. Hearing their frustrations made us realize how **outdated the system is**, and we knew technology could do better.

launches.body:
### **Tl;dr**

[Baseline’s](https://www.baselinetrials.com/) AI platform helps pharmaceutical companies eliminate months of manual work during clinical trials by automating the study build, data transformation, and analysis creation. This can save a single trial up to $18M in direct costs and lost revenue.

### **⚠️ Problem**

The main document in a clinical trial is the study protocol. At large companies, floors of people use the protocol to create the study data collection forms, clinical database design, error checks, analysis code, and data transformation mappings. This makes the process both expensive and time-consuming, with **a single day lost** in a clinical trial **costing** [**50k-300k** (depending on phase)](https://baselineai.notion.site/Cost-of-1-Day-By-Stage-af2f3e4008444ed8a819d288d45fd31d?pvs=74). 

### **🚀 Solution**

We offer a three-part solution:

* **Baseline Build**
  * Processes the study protocol to create the study data collection forms, clinical database design, and error checks
* **Baseline Harmonize**
  * Transforms data from external sources into the desired format based on the database model
* **Baseline Analyze**
  * Uses the study protocol and database model to create the analysis tables and figures

Implementing our AI workflows can **save a single phase 3 clinical trial up to $18M** in direct costs and lost revenue.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83484&key=user_uploads/718972/f7dbfa5f-f8d8-436f-9ee5-29139b3f9de7)

**📘 Backstory**

We’re [Nabil](https://linkedin.com/in/nabil-baugher-93822a18a) and [Zoe](https://linkedin.com/in/zoesheill) — two recent MIT grads who want to help bring new treatments to patients in need faster. We noticed that despite drug discovery being faster than ever, new treatments for things our friends and family needed seemed to rarely make it to market. Zoe also participated in a clinical trial herself and wanted to see the system improve. 

### **🙏 Ask**

If you or anyone you know are in pharma/biotech or running clinical trials, we’d love to chat! Please reach out to us at [founders@baselinetrials.com](mailto:founders@baselinetrials.com).

launches.body:
[HealthSpark](https://www.joinhealthspark.com/) empowers physical therapists (PTs) to start, run, and grow their own independent practices. Our AI-native “business-in-a-box” takes care of the administrative work—insurance billing, patient onboarding, documentation, and scheduling—so PTs can focus on patient care, not paperwork.

# The Problem

In a traditional clinic, office managers and billing staff handle everything outside of direct care: credentialing with insurers, scheduling, patient intake, claims, and compliance. For PTs who want to go independent, all of that work falls on their shoulders. It’s time-consuming, complex, and costly, which discourages many from ever starting a successful practice.

# Our Solution

HealthSpark gives PTs the administrative infrastructure of a full clinic without the overhead of hiring staff. Our AI-enabled back office handles the core workflows of running a practice—insurance credentialing, scheduling, patient intake, documentation, and revenue cycle management—so providers can focus entirely on care.

PTs run their practice on our custom EHR, designed with smart task reminders and equipped with an AI scribe to keep documentation and compliance on track. They also join our multi-state provider network, making it simple to go in-network with major insurers.

Behind the scenes, HealthSpark deploys AI agents to handle the manual workflows that normally require a team of back-office staff. Our agents process unstructured paperwork like referrals, insurance cards, and faxed records, navigate insurance portals to verify benefits, and coordinate with other providers and health systems over phone and fax.

launches.body:
Lifters, runners, triathletes, cyclists: you can now turn your personal AI agent into a fitness coach with HYBRD. Once you connect to the HYBRD MCP, your AI agent will be able to: 

* Access and understand all your historical training data
* Use that data to make workouts and training plans
* Push those recommendations to your device (watch and/or phone) so you can execute the workouts

**To get set up, just paste this into Claude / Muse / Instinct:** 

set up <https://hybrd.com/resources/mcp-setup/skill.md> \
\
Millions of athletes already build training plans inside their favorite AI tool. But those tools have no access to wearable data, no memory from one session to the next, and no way to get a workout from the chat window onto an athlete's watch. HYBRD MCP closes that gap.

The first thing you should try with HYBRD MCP is to ask something like: 

* Across all my runs, when did I have the best ratio between grade adjusted pace and heart rate?
* What was my most consistent phase ever? 
* What was the difference between my Napa Marathon prep and Boston Marathon prep?

Then have it write you a training plan for your next goal: 

* Using the workouts I did most consistently, come up with a plan for Ironman California
* Help me ramp back up to what I used to lift while maintaining my running volume
* I’m traveling and will only have access to hotel gyms for a while, modify my current training plan

HYBRD will write those workouts back to your wearable and phone, so you just have to click “start” and you’ll get guided through the plan

You can also use our companion mobile app to make tracking lifting easy, or track your runs using your phone’s GPS if you don’t have a smartwatch. 

HYBRD will manage your wearables connection, be a system of record for your training plan / completed workouts, and steer LLMs towards giving better fitness coaching

The experience gets especially magical with tools like Muse or Instinct, which can proactively check the local weather, block off time on your calendar, order the right fueling for you etc. 

Sleep, recovery and nutrition data support are coming in the next few days. 

We have a few thousand athletes on HYBRD so far, check out what they’re doing with it below:

launches.body:
Hey YC! We’re the team behind HYBRD - Ruiters, Shoe, Ben, Michael and Mats. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100595&key=user_uploads/1315661/b570d491-7243-4a3c-8660-ca425a646339)

We’re excited to share that today **HYBRD is becoming a coach in your pocket.** It’s like having a $500/month private coach on call 24/7. We provide a world-class training plan, then adapt it based on your life, progress, and recovery to keep you on track. 

\
[LINK TO DEMO VIDEO](https://youtube.com/shorts/PgPKkJqbYs0)

ASK: [TRY IT NOW ON THE APP STORE](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hybrd-get-faster-stronger/id6670271875)

\
**Introducing HYBRD Brain**

HYBRD Brain is our AI-powered coach built on top of HYBRD's structured training plans. Tell Brain about your schedule, sport mix, travel, or injuries — and it restructures your entire plan accordingly.

## **⭐ Why HYBRD is different**

These aren't ChatGPT-slop training plans.

We've partnered with Alex Viada (creator of the term "hybrid athlete") and his Complete Human Performance team to use their world-class programming as HYBRD's foundation. Our agent adapts those plans to you while preserving best-in-class athletic methodology.

(Alex also bought an iPhone just to use HYBRD)

**HYBRD Brain can coach you to achieve anything**

* Training for a marathon but also playing soccer twice a week? HYBRD Brain adjusts your running volume.
* Tweaked your Achilles and need to back off temporarily? HYBRD Brain rebuilds your training block.
* Traveling for work and missed three sessions? HYBRD Brain recalculates what comes next so you don’t lose momentum.

Instead of forcing you to follow a plan that breaks on contact with reality, HYBRD Brain builds a plan that adapts to you. 

**HYBRD actually does things**

Chatting with your health data is cool, but not useful. Most apps just regurgitate your charts back to you (you know how to read a graph) and recommend the CDC's 75 minutes of vigorous activity per week.

These tools feel disappointing because they don't know your actual goals and constraints, like upcoming races, equipment and your schedule, so they can't do anything meaningful with the data they collect.

HYBRD understands your goals and proactively proposes adjustments that fit your plan. Unplanned workouts, missed sessions, fatigue, cross-training, new PRs… HYBRD recognizes these moments and reorganizes your schedule around them.

**HYBRD uses ALL of your workout data**

Every workout you do is a puzzle piece in a broader picture of performance. But fitness tracking data is siloed across multiple domains. You might track your running data on a Garmin, your sleep/recovery on WHOOP and your strength training in a spreadsheet. 

It kinda works if you’re _just_ a runner or _just_ a lifter.

But more and more people are becoming “hybrid” athletes who focus on strength _and_ cardio, so they’re left stitching together multiple data sources to see the full picture.

Do it wrong and you risk “cardio killing your gains”

**HYBRD is adaptive to your history, current level and progress**

HYBRD integrates with all leading wearables and data sources, pulling in your full workout history and deduplicating it. From that data, we give you a holistic view of your strength and cardio fitness, normalized for age, gender, and weight, as a single score you can track over time.

Cycling, running, rowing, lifting: we interpret it all to model your physiology and personalize your plan.

Say you want to train more like Alex Viada. You probably aren't deadlifting 700lbs and logging 15+ hours a week (yet?). We scale the fundamentals of his programming down to exactly where you are now.

**FitBench**

Ok, it wouldn't be an AI launch without benchmarking.

We built **FitBench**, a benchmark that evaluates an AI coach across four dimensions: Scientific accuracy, athlete safety, recommendation actionability and conciseness across 25 common coaching scenarios. We used Opus 4.6 as an LLM-as-a-judge to score HYBRD Brain against current ChatGPT and its predecessors.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100595&key=user_uploads/1315661/c6e545d7-114b-4cc5-9e1f-806f7197e7d2)

But how does that compare with human coaches?

We had HYBRD sit for the **Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist (CSCS)** exam, which is the gold standard in coaching. You need 70% to pass (half of all human test-takers don't make it). HYBRD scored 77%.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100595&key=user_uploads/1315661/4cfa2415-0d8f-4106-850b-f15fcf307d54)

\
**Our Story**

Ben, Mats, and Shoe all met while working on getting WHOOP to PMF. At the time, outside of work, Mats was training on the US national rowing team and Ben + Shoe were making their first forays into Ironman training.

We realized that fitness hardware was getting really good, but also was being commoditized. (Just take a look at Coros brutally undercutting Garmin prices)

For all the data being collected, existing products weren’t providing real coaching to multi-disciplinary “hybrid” athletes like us, partly because none were built to handle strength + cardio data, and partly because models weren’t good enough. 

Most athletes are still following static PDF plans they found online, or "adaptive" apps that fall apart the moment cross-training enters the picture.

We teamed up with our co-founder and CTO Ruiters (a senior AWS engineer at the time) and Michael (our founding engineer) to solve that with HYBRD. 

If that problem resonates with you, [try a 7 day free trial of HYBRD!](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hybrd-get-faster-stronger/id6670271875)

* Do this by trying our 7 day free trial (find us on the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hybrd-get-faster-stronger/id6670271875))
* Stay motivated by joining our free weekly workout clubs in San Francisco and Boston (email me at [mats@hybrd.app](mailto:mats@hybrd.app) to join the groupchat)
* Pay it forward by sharing HYBRD with the most athletic people you know

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95448&key=user_uploads/1315661/2636ea96-f4e3-4c5a-9fb9-03a49e4d7e30)

(pictured above is Alex Viada - if you’re not familiar, he wrote the first book on hybrid training and an inspiration to many, many coaches and athletes in this space. He bought an iPhone just to try HYBRD and we’ve since launched a partnership to provide his training plans on the platform)\
\
**Ok.. I want to be strong and fast, but what are you actually building?**

We break down the silos between your cardio, strength and wearable data to give you a complete view of your performance.

Then we use that data to personalize training plans from world-class coaches to you. We’re ex-WHOOP, ex-US national rowing team, triathletes / ultramarathoners ourselves and are building the training platform that we wish had existed for us.\
\
**Why do I need a separate app for this?**

Every workout you do is a puzzle piece in a broader picture of performance. But fitness tracking data is siloed across multiple domains. You might track your running data on a Garmin, your sleep/recovery on WHOOP and your strength training in a spreadsheet.

It kinda works if you’re _just_ a runner or _just_ a lifter.

But more and more people are becoming “hybrid” athletes who focus on strength _and_ cardio, so they’re left stitching together multiple data sources to see the full picture.

Do it wrong and you risk “cardio killing your gains”

**What are you guys doing about it?**

First, HYBRD integrates with all leading wearables and data sources. We pull in as much historical data as we can. We pull in your workouts and deduplicate them.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95448&key=user_uploads/1315661/ea007cfa-7a37-4fe1-ac3a-cf3766489e8f)

Then, we make it really easy to track your weightlifting, CrossFit, HYROX - things that aren’t well suited for tracking on a wearable.

You can use text to input your workout to our AI logger - or, simply upload a picture of your training journal, a whiteboard from a HYROX gym, or a screenshot from an app you already use.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95448&key=user_uploads/1315661/d7b6ae82-a69f-44ef-85de-eafad05467e6)

Based on that data, we provide a holistic view of your strength and cardio abilities, normalized for age/gender/weight and give you a single score (analogous to a chess Elo score) that you can use to track your progress.

Cycling, running, rowing, lifting data can all be interpreted and used to model your physiology.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95448&key=user_uploads/1315661/40a31bf9-1e3d-4cf3-98e1-f8b3ea2cd8a4)

That gives us all the information we need to know to personalize a training plan for you.

For example - lets say you want to be more like Alex Viada, the guy I mentioned above. You might not deadlift 700lb+ and be training 15+ hours a week (yet?), so we can scale down the fundamentals of his training plan to whatever is right for you:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95448&key=user_uploads/1315661/316c1a00-295f-4498-a9a7-52a70ed43a06)

These training plans have been developed by likely the most reputable coaching organization in hybrid athletics - Complete Human Performance (shout out to Alex as well as Trevor Tartaglia and Ariana Scalfo!)

And once you have that workout plan, we can push it directly to your Garmin (Coros + Apple Watch coming soon), so you can easily run through the workout on the go.

You’ll be motivated to keep making progress by pushing up your Training Score, which is the first metric to encapsulate both strength and cardio training load, developed by us and Anna Cruse, the Director of Applied Health and Performance Science at the University of Utah.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95448&key=user_uploads/1315661/c04f9964-96e3-457c-a1e5-b03c8fd2fc8c)

**Where is this all going?**

We’ve already had hundreds of thousands of workouts get processed when HYBRD was a tracking-only app, so we’re really pumped about taking things to the next level by adding in adaptive programming.

We’re going to keep adding more plan types (HYROX, triathlon coming soon) as well as more personalization levers (probably sleep + recovery etc.)

Right now we’re iOS only but stay tuned on the Android side.

**Who are you to tell me how to get stronger + faster..?**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95448&key=user_uploads/1315661/3a16ba00-2b5e-4607-bda2-b0152ec649a2)

**Well, we’ve got a great team!**

(from left to right)

* our CTO [**@Matt Ruiters**](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/1833503) was a USA Rugby All-American and a former senior SWE at AWS
* [**@Caroline "Shoe" Shoemaker**](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/1862703) was the first analytics hire at WHOOP, later GM for a productivity app portfolio at Appex and is racing an Ironman this weekend
* CEO [**@Ben Katz**](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/1851275) led growth at WHOOP, later GM for a fitness app portfolio at Appex and is also racing an Ironman (against Shoe) this weekend
* Our founding engineer Michael Battaglia is a former WHOOP software engineer and rowed for Cornell
* [**@Mats Terwiesch**](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/1315661) was a core product manager at WHOOP, was concurrently on the US National Rowing Team, ran a 50mi ultramarathon last weekend and previously published health + AI research at Harvard

and we’re just getting started!

launches.title: FutureClinic: Healthcare that's 99% AI, 1% doctor.
launches.tagline: We make it easy for any doctor or hospital to open their own AI-first digital clinic.
launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

* Most AI healthcare companies have been focusing on administrative tasks (authorizations/ scribing). We’re focusing on the main bottleneck in healthcare - clinical expertise. Our AI thinks like a doctor.
* It conducts comprehensive medical histories via voice interface, performs medical reasoning, and suggests evidence-based treatments / next steps (99% of the healthcare journey).
* Doctors can efficiently review text-based summaries on a back-end dashboard in under a minute, and maintain final medical decision-making control (the high value 1%).

<https://youtu.be/cUoLpodvLwE?si=fUzpo4LD3y3rzqtT>

---

### **The Problem**

1. **Traditional healthcare delivery is broken, with a fundamental supply/demand mismatch between the need for healthcare, and the number of doctors available to provide it.**
2. **The US healthcare system is facing a physician crisis**
   * Projected shortage of 86,000 physicians by 2036
   * 30% of physicians are leaving the field or moving part-time in the next 5 years due to the lack flexibility or burnout.
   * Patient volumes per physician are exploding, overwhelming doctors' capacity to deliver quality care
3. **Existing attempts to solve these problems have been step changes, and fail to lessen the burden of care on doctors:**
   * Traditional Telehealth simply moved the same broken workflows online, amounting to the same workload, if not more (”I think you’re on mute, Mrs. Jones…”)
   * Asynchronous messaging currently requires a lot of back and forth and hasn’t achieved adoption
   * Administrative streamlining AI services are great, but don’t tackle the fundamental bottleneck in healthcare which is clinical expertise.

### **The Solution**

FutureClinic is an EHR platform that powers digital medical clinics with sophisticated AI that handles 99% of the work, letting doctors focus purely on medical decision-making.

Our platform:

* Takes comprehensive medical histories through an empathetic voice interface
* Uses advanced medical reasoning to narrow down diagnoses
* Provides evidence-based treatment suggestions
* Presents doctors with concise text-based summaries, with all key findings cited
* Enables asynchronous care delivery without video/phone calls
* Built-in safety protocols flag potential contraindications and risks.
* Closes care gaps for patients with language barriers

---

### **Our Vision**

* Our EHR starts by powering digital medical clinics, but we ultimately power healthcare delivery in brick and mortar clinics and hospitals too.

---

### **About Us**

* 3 out of 4 co-founders are medical doctors as well as software engineers from top institutions (UCL, Imperial College London, Mount Sinai)
* Combined experience of >10,000 real-world patient encounters, with a deep understanding of physician needs and pain points (and scar tissue to prove it!)
* In previous roles, we’ve directly helped open >40 real world medical clinics in New York in the last 3 years, and know what it takes to deliver end-to-end care in a legal, compliant, and safe manner.
* Our President has >300,000 followers on social media, largely doctors and medical students, giving us an unfair advantage for early distribution.

### **Reach out!**

_For Doctors_**:** If you're interested in starting your own digit clinic with complete flexibility and control, visit [**openclinic.com**](http://tryopenclinic.com) to sign up or email [**founders@openclinic.com**](mailto:founders@tryopenclinic.com)

_For Healthcare Organizations_**:** If you're looking to launch a digital clinic or use our system for patient intake, we'd love to discuss how OpenClinic can help. Email [**founders@openclinic.com**](mailto:riyan@tryopenclinic.com)

### **TL;DR**

* **Autonomously Sync. Analyze. Identify** unrealized revenue across all portals and plans, without needing to spend time & $$ integrating systems.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cWwsuSoAHgk

Even after spending almost $800B/yr (almost 70% of revenue) on staffing, Healthcare organizations leave 2/3rd of care unserviced, costing 30% in bookings & $250B/year in care coordination waste.

Most care coordination & data sharing is still manually done by staff through phones, email, fax because of unintegrated systems and custom workflows too unique to automate out of the box.

launches.body:
### **Tl;dr**

* [Toothy.ai](http://Toothy.ai) is building HIPAA-compliant AI agents that automate all the back office functions in a dental practice. Our first two agents automate the entire revenue cycle, so dental practices can sit back and watch the insurance payments roll in [😎](https://emojipedia.org/smiling-face-with-sunglasses)
* Our AI handles everything from insurance verification, claim creation, claim submission, denial correction, claim resubmission, and payment posting.
* We're already seeing early customers cutting their back office teams by 50-75% within weeks of implementing Toothy.

### **Launch video**

<https://youtu.be/y5VQe82PdGI>

### **❌ The problem**

* Dental practices **waste 800 million hours** and **$13.2 billion** per year on time-consuming and repetitive back-office tasks. On top of that, dental practices are facing an unprecedented labor shortage and **90**% of them find it extremely or very challenging to fill vacant positions.
* The largest, most time-consuming, and error-prone part of a dental practice’s back office is revenue cycle management (RCM)—the process of getting paid. **80%** of dental practices face financial concerns due to RCM challenges. Tasks like insurance verification, claim submission, and payment posting are labor-intensive and prone to errors. Frequent policy changes make it difficult to verify coverage, leading to billing discrepancies and delayed payments.

### **✅ The solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87923&key=user_uploads/2386492/97bc335c-1d5b-4c4a-ab85-e45f800ca7b2)

* Toothy’s AI agents automate the entire RCM process, **saving practices 160+ hours per month and increasing revenue by 5-10%**. Our AI agents handle everything from insurance verification to payment posting, eliminating the largest source of administrative burden.
* How do our agents work?
  1. **☎️ Verify Insurance** – Calls payers and check online portals to confirm coverage.
  2. 📝 **Input data** - Fills out and uploads a comprehensive breakdown form with 50+ codes into your practice management system.
  3. 📬 **Create and submit claims** - Accesses imaging software, clinical remarks, and plan details to create & submit comprehensive claims.
  4. 🛠️ **Correct denials** - Understands denial reasons, updates the claim, and resubmits to payers. Can even draft appeal letters.
  5. **💰 Payment posting** - Collects, scans, and deposits insurance checks into your bank account.
* Toothy becomes your full-time RCM team, reducing staff workload and ensuring faster, higher reimbursements.

### **🙏 Our Ask**

* Toothy is already working with dozens of forward-thinking dental practices who never want to deal with insurance again. If that sounds like you, we'd love to talk:
  * 👉 Book a demo: [Here](https://calendly.com/toothy-ai/toothy-ai-demo)
  * Learn more: [toothy.ai](http://toothy.ai)
* For other inquiries, please email [founders@toothy.ai](mailto:founders@toothy.ai)

launches.title: Amby Health - AI Copilot for Ambulance Agencies (EMS)
launches.tagline: We automate EMS quality reviews and billing, reducing errors, maximizing revenue, and improving patient care.
launches.body:
We’re Yos and Timmy – co-founders of [Amby Health](https://tryamby.com) 👋

# **TL;DR**

Ambulance agencies (EMS) waste time and lose revenue due to manual quality reviews and billing, leading to missed errors, under-documented care, and delayed reimbursements. Amby Health automates the entire process, ensuring 100% of patient reports (PCRs) are reviewed in real-time, helping agencies increase revenue, reduce workload, and improve patient care.

Know any **EMS Directors/CEOs or Fire Department Captains**? Please introduce us! 

Email: [contact@amby.health](mailto:contact@amby.health)

# **The Team**

**Yos (CEO):**  MIT dropout, ex-Meta engineer, ML researcher at MIT CSAIL, and former engineer at Allm, a company providing pre-hospital emergency care. He saw firsthand how outdated, manual EMS documentation and billing slow down providers and reduce revenue.

**Timmy (CTO):** – MIT dropout, ex-Amazon/Bloomberg engineer, AI researcher at MIT Media Lab, and healthcare data scientist at OM1. He saw how valuable insights are buried in unstructured medical records, making it hard for providers to act on critical data.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87974&key=user_uploads/541108/0d47eceb-120d-4b66-acd1-d3f1a67db38a)

# **The Problem**

EMS quality reviews and billing are still manual and inefficient, leading to:

* **Missed Errors & Compliance Risks** – Incomplete patient reports (PCRs) slip through, leading to under-documented care, protocol violations, and legal exposure.
* **Lost Revenue & Billing Delays** – EMS teams spend hours fixing reports, chasing down medics, and resubmitting claims. Agencies miss out on millions due to denials, coding errors, and charge capture gaps.
* **Slow, Labor-Intensive Process** – Quality review and billing teams are bogged down by manual chart reviews and corrections, delaying reimbursements and patient care improvements.

 

# **Our Solution: AI-Powered EMS Quality Review & Billing**

✅ **Automated Quality Audits** – Identifies errors, missing documentation, and compliance risks instantly.\
✅ **Real-Time Medic Feedback** – Helps providers improve documentation and protocol adherence with instant insights.\
✅ **Billing Optimization** – Ensures complete PCRs, flags missed charges and reduces denials to speed up payments.

The result? EMS agencies recover lost revenue, cut review times, and improve patient care—while reducing manual work. 

One fire department **increased EMS revenue by 33%** (from $350K to $500K) simply by improving its review process.

# **Demo**

<https://youtu.be/eH2ddSKFZOI>

---

**Our Ask**

* Know any EMS Directors/CEOs or Fire Department Captains? Introduce us!
* Reach us at: [contact@amby.health](mailto:contact@amby.health)
* Learn more: [tryamby.com](http://tryamby.com)

name: Mecha Health
long_description:
Mecha Health builds foundation models to automate x-ray analysis for radiologists. We take medical images and process them using proprietary models to produce accurate draft medical reports. Our first model was built in less than two months, and beat Microsoft, Google, and OpenAI on clinical accuracy metrics. On top of that, it’s two orders of magnitude smaller and trained with a quarter of the data.

We are partnering with the largest privately owned radiology practice in the US and a multinational tele-radiology company to provide them with their own foundation model, enabling their radiologists to go from reading 1 scan per hour to 1 scan every 5 minutes. By charging on a per scan basis, x-ray report generation represents a 40B+ market opportunity.

launches.body:
**TLDR;** \
Mecha Health helps radiologists save time and effort by producing draft reports of medical images using AI. \
\
**The Problem: Too Many Scans Not Enough Doctors.** \
Due to a shortage of experts, US radiologists have to read 100 - 250+ studies per day, and this means that 55% have reported high levels of burnout. Additionally, patients sometimes have to wait days to receive medical reports for their scans due to backlogs. At times, this can result in preventable patient harm. \
\
**Our Solution: Accurate & Interpretable Medical Image Analysis.** \
We improve the reporting process by producing draft reports with AI and have invented new science to do this both accurately and safely. Our system can trace every finding to its visual source in the image and evidence each finding with examples from the training dataset. This allows for transparent reporting that doctors can trust.

### **TL;DR**

**Asteroid** is the fastest way to build self-healing browser agents, no technical experience required. \
\
Our new **AI agent builder**, **Astro**, allows you to build **complex, multistep browser agents** by building an agent graph, writing prompts, adding tools, human in the loop and guardrails.

This makes Asteroid agents suitable for **mission-critical workflows**, and more than **25 businesses** already use them in healthcare, insurance, and beyond.\
\
**Astro** **is fully available, build your agent [here](https://platform.asteroid.ai/)!**

https://youtu.be/ugY_qLTfmG8

### **What is the problem?**

Startups need to integrate with external portals (carriers, suppliers, healthcare) but can’t wait months for APIs.

Many great browser-agent frameworks have emerged in the past year, but **non-technical teams still can’t build production-grade agents.**

Operations leaders, PMs, and founders are the ones who **understand the workflows and edge cases** and _should_ be the builders. Relying on developers to constantly fix prompts for every new edge case isn’t sustainable.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96061&key=user_uploads/1651915/d73eee4d-bcc6-461f-953e-6fdd56374905)

### **Solution: Astro - AI Builder for Complex Browser Agents**

Today we’re launching **Astro**, our AI builder that lets anyone create **complex, self-healing browser agents in under 2 minutes**. Tell Astro what you want, for example _“Build an agent to pull patient data from this EHR”_, and it generates the full agent.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96061&key=user_uploads/1651915/53714daf-535a-450a-8a76-82eb70d43007)

**Astro improves the agent using previous runs.** Behind the scenes, it writes code when needed, including Playwright scripts for deterministic steps, giving everyone code-level reliability.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96061&key=user_uploads/1651915/62627740-6f1e-47ce-a197-917e01ceade7)

Every part of the agent, including graphs, prompts, and model settings, is fully visible so you can make precise, surgical edits whenever needed.

### **How does it work**

1. **Build:** Non-technical teams create agents directly in the platform. Astro generates the prompts, agent graphs, and tools needed to handle even the most complex browser workflows.
2. **Deploy:** Developers drop in a single code snippet to call the agent through Asteroid’s API/SDKs.
3. **Supervise:** Monitor live sessions, review recordings, track performance, and trigger human-in-the-loop via Slack when needed.
4. **Improve:** Non-technical teams update prompts and ship new agent versions instantly as workflows change.

### **Ship your first agent today**

**Astro** **is fully available, try it for free [here](https://platform.asteroid.ai/) or book a [demo](https://cal.com/asteroidai/15min) with a founder!**

launches.title: Asteroid: Browser Agents with Human Oversight
launches.tagline: Browser workflow automation for regulated industries
launches.body:
**Asteroid makes browser automation seamless for regulated industries.** Not only developers but also non-technical teams can **build and run our browser agents with Asteroid**, turning 45-minute manual tasks into 2-minute automated processes.

Our browser agents can navigate legacy portals, fill out forms, and extract data—all without brittle scripts, high costs, or maintenance headaches.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88012&key=user_uploads/1651915/50a0915f-b720-4fff-923b-0b84e6017098)

### **The Problem**

Traditional automation tools like RPA are too expensive for non-enterprise customers, **costing $10,000 per automation**. Meanwhile, scaleups especially in high-risk industries like insurance or healthcare lack the resources to maintain Selenium or Playwright scripts, as these frequently break due to UI changes and the automations need to be extremely reliable.

### **The Solution**

Browser agents bridge this gap—offering the flexibility of scripting with the reliability of RPA. With 2025’s computer use models, **web automation is now 100x cheaper and more robust, unlocking thousands of new use cases.**

### **How It Works**

**Asteroid transforms any browser task into an agentic workflow.** Simply show Asteroid what to do—via a screen recording, SOP, or written instructions—and get an agentic workflow. You can then call it through our web UI or API.

Behind the scenes, Asteroid spins up a secure, headless browser, handles authentication, executes workflows, and seamlessly integrates human review when needed—all without burdening your developers. We ensure the agent improves over time.\
🔗 [Watch Asteroid in action](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=26uksP36xB4)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88012&key=user_uploads/1651915/fa0c7345-c244-4270-8c56-c905072f93ea)

### **Highlighted Features**

🔹 **API-First Automation** – Trigger a browser agent in a web UI or with a single API call—no need for complex scripts or RPA setups.\
🔹 **Human-in-the-Loop** – Automate only where it’s safe, with built-in escalation for manual review when needed.\
🔹 **Intelligent Guardrails** – Set rules like “Never click this button” or “Ask before submitting” to prevent errors.\
🔹 **Continuous Learning** – Asteroid evaluates every execution, adapting to website changes and improving over time using evaluations and backtesting.

### **How We Got Here**

We’re both AI engineers who had to solve the same problem independently. Joe built AI systems that stopped $100M+ in fraud annually. David developed fraud investigation agents for fintechs.

After years of building mission-critical automation, we learned that automation only works with intelligent guardrails, human oversight, and continuous learning.

We first built Asteroid as a developer tool for safe AI deployment—offering guardrails, human-in-the-loop workflows, and continuous evaluations. But we quickly realized:

\*\*Browser agents need these safeguards even more.\*\*\
✅ **Guardrails** – "Don’t click on this."\
✅ **Human oversight** – "Ping me before you submit."\
✅ **Continuous learning** – "The website changed—adapt."

Instead of just developer tools, we’ve shifted to building browser agents with safety and reliability baked in!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88012&key=user_uploads/1651915/e9051949-8032-4fc5-951d-1fb8361ba3e1)

### **Real-World Use Cases**

We’re working with customers to automate high-value workflows like:

🔹 **Insurance Portal Automation** – Retrieve broker quotes across insurer portals—without manual input.\
🔹 **Supply Chain Scheduling** – Log into carrier platforms, retrieve GPS data, and schedule deliveries—seamlessly.\
🔹 **Expense Management** – Pull PDF bills from utility portals for expense tracking—without APIs.

### **Who is Asteroid for?**

🔹**Businesses with Heavy Manual Browser Workflows** – Automate large-scale data entry, form submissions, and repetitive portal interactions.\
🔹**Regulated Businesses using Legacy Systems** – Streamline automation for industries like insurance, healthcare and supply chain.\
🔹**AI Agent Startups** – Enable AI agents to reliably interact with legacy portals and automate browser tasks.

### **Get Started**

**Have a repetitive workflow you'd love to automate?** Let’s explore how Asteroid can help!\
🔹 [Schedule a demo](https://calendly.com/founders-asteroid-hhaf/30min?month=2025-02) to discuss your use case!\
🔹[Try our default agents](https://platform.asteroid.ai/) and see browser automation in action!

launches.title: Harbera 🏥 AI healthcare provider credentialing
launches.tagline: Harbera helps hospitals and clinic groups keep their doctors credentialed and compliant.
launches.body:
Veronica and Sophia here, we’re building Harbera. Harbera is AI software that helps healthcare organizations keep their providers - physicians, dentists, nurse practitioners - in-network with insurers and compliant.

<https://youtu.be/75SKmVEMBvs>

## Without credentials doctors can’t treat patients

Credentialing is the bureaucratic process of verifying a providers’ qualifications and contracting them with insurance plans. The 900+ insurance companies across the U.S. have different and ever-changing credentialing requirements, and providers need to be re-credentialed regularly. 

Keeping providers credentialed is critical. If a provider falls out-of-network, it can take months to get credentialed again. Health systems are often unaware that a provider has fallen out-of-network until claims start getting denied, leading to disrupted patient care and billions in lost revenue.

## Monitoring credentialing is hard and gets harder at scale

There’s a lot that administrators need to keep track of: updates to insurance plan requirements (often mailed), license and certification expirations, malpractice sanctions, re-credentialing timelines, and more. Today, many back-office teams at hospitals and clinic groups use spreadsheets, filing cabinets, or even repurpose tools like Salesforce to track credentialing.

Here’s why monitoring is challenging for organizations:

* A telehealth company that accepts 10 insurance plans and works with 100 therapists across 30 states needs to track up to 30,000 statuses.
* A dental group working with 200 dentists needs to track 8,000 statuses. (Dentists are enrolled in over 40 insurance plans on average.)

## What we’re doing

We are making credentialing easy. Our software integrates with a healthcare organization’s existing systems to continuously monitor and proactively re-credential providers across states and insurance plans. We keep administrators in the loop so providers never fall out-of-network. We make onboarding new providers seamless with real-time document validation. We analyze credentialing trends to identify revenue growth opportunities and optimize staffing.

## About us

We’re best friends from college. We studied and taught Computer Science together at Harvard. [Veronica](https://www.linkedin.com/in/veronicanutting/) was a software engineer at Stripe, and [Sophia](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sophia--clark/) was a software engineer at House Rx, a specialty pharmacy software startup serving clinics across the country.

## Ask

Do you know health leaders that work in multi-state or multi-practice healthcare organizations, like dental support organizations (DSOs), telehealth companies, hospitals, or clinic groups? We’d love to meet them!

Email [founders@harbera.com](mailto:founders@harbera.com) to get in touch 🦡🧡

launches.tagline: Meet G LNK, the AI one-stop shop for all medical interactions
launches.body:
Hey YC!

We’re [Raouf](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2360566) and [Rayan](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2366179) — co-founders of G LNK

**TL;DR**

G LNK is an AI-powered platform that connects Pharma companies with doctors & researchers. Rayan worked on this as a consultant, where Pharma companies spent billions annually just to determine how much to pay doctors while staying within regulatory guidelines. Using LLMs, we’re automating the end-to-end process—from identifying candidates to compensation and compliance.\
<https://youtu.be/16oP6roNnZk>

**Problem**

Pharma companies spend over **$70 billion annually** on engaging doctors & researchers, yet a lot of that money is wasted on outdated and manual processes:

* **Outsourcing is expensive and slow**: Companies spend millions on third parties (consulting, recruiting, and regulatory firms)  just to find the right experts and to know how much to pay them compliantly.
* **Compliance risks are high**: Payment miscalculations can lead to regulatory violations and hefty fines
* **Data is scattered**: Contracts, payments and compliance tracking are spread across disconnected systems, making transparency and oversight difficult

<https://youtu.be/qDdFbMWO6eU>

**Solution**

**G LNK automates Pharma companies' entire healthcare professional (HCP) engagement process**—from identifying suitable doctors to engaging them. Here’s how it works:

1. **Identify HCPs:**
   * Identify a doctor from our database of over 3.2 million user profiles (growing 250% MoM).
   * Alternatively, if you know who you want to engage, simply upload the doctor’s CV and we will take care of the rest.
2. **Calculate Compensation:**
   * Instantly determine their compensation rates.
   * Adjust the rates dynamically based on factors such as service type and travel requirements.
3. **Engage Directly:**
   * Contact the selected doctors directly through our platform.
4. **Ensure Compliance:**
   * Maintain regulatory compliance and prevent compliance violations before they happen.
   * Leverage real-time data from trusted sources like NIH, PubMed, CBS, CMS, and more.

This step-by-step solution replaces multiple vendors with a single AI-powered platform, ensuring efficient, compliant, and cost-effective HCP engagement.

**Additional Features**

* **Built-in CRM** to track all HCP engagements
* **Comprehensive financial tracking**, including:
  * All Transfer of Value payments made to HCPs (date, purpose, associated drug)
  * Drug coverage breakdown
  * Monthly payment summaries
  * Payment analysis by Therapeutic Area
* **Tailored recommendations** for grants, conferences, and publications for HCPs
* **Centralized database** of regulations and Codes of Conduct across 150+ countries

**Team**

Rayan and Raouf have known each other for over a decade, with their professional relationship cementing itself during their time as researchers at the University of Chicago.

**Rayan (CEO)** worked as a Life-Sciences Consultant at PwC and was recognized as top consulting analyst in the US for pioneering automation in pharmaceutical compliance. He holds degrees in Chemistry & Economics at UChicago, where he was one of the youngest biochemistry researchers at Pritzker School of Engineering.

**Raouf (CTO)** worked as a ML-researcher at AxLab, where he specialized in developing neural network architectures for multimodal human-computer interaction with adaptive reinforcement learning. He has a multidisciplinary background, with degrees in Computer Science, Astrophysics, & Economics from UChicago

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88235&key=user_uploads/2366179/8a3b2573-1a0d-499b-b252-94260eb9ca1d)

**We are on a mission to help Pharma companies cut costs, enhance accuracy with better benchmarking, and save valuable time. By streamlining these critical processes, we empower Pharma to focus more resources on manufacturing, distribution, and supply—accelerating the delivery of life-changing treatments to those who need them most.**

**Our Asks**

We would really appreciate introductions to anyone working in the Pharma industry or any health-related verticals. Additionally, if you know any physician/research communities, we would love to talk and learn more!

launches.tagline: Scale AI for Medical Scans
launches.body:
Hey everyone, we’re [Nikhil](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nikhiltiwari-iitb/) & [Shivesh](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shivesh-gupta-iitb/), co-founders of Frekil!  👋

## TL;DR

Frekil is an end-to-end platform to procure and annotate medical imaging datasets like Xrays, CTs, MRIs, etc 10x faster with AI assistance. We’ve partnered with radiology chains for large-scale imaging data, and have a global marketplace of radiologists for rapid, high-quality annotations.

https://youtu.be/2MYjUFp3r0Q?feature=shared

## ❗The Problem

AI is transforming healthcare, but the biggest bottleneck is still **access to medical images from hospitals and annotations by expert doctors**.

Healthcare AI and life sciences companies spend millions collecting medical images and hiring expert radiologists. But annotations? They're still:

📝 Manual\
🐢 Slow\
🔍 Hard to QA

Finding expert annotators with deep domain knowledge is tough, which means R&D teams waste months and large budgets on a process that should be seamless.

Medical annotation itself is uniquely challenging because it involves:

📦 Gigabyte-scale files\
🧠 Complex, multi-dimensional data that’s sensitive to loss\
🎯 Accuracy that’s absolutely critical

Yet most teams still use open-source desktop tools like 3D Slicer, built decades ago for solo researchers. These tools:

🚫 Require local machines\
📉 Offer no real-time collaboration\
📊 Force spreadsheet-based coordination\
🔐 Risk compliance and data security

And the result?\
Highly trained radiologists are stuck doing repetitive tasks manually wasting time, slowing innovation, and compromising data quality.

## 🧠 Our Solution

We transform the way healthcare AI teams prepare data by **accelerating and streamlining the entire annotation pipeline** — cutting timelines from months down to days.

Here’s how:

✅ Deliver fully annotated **medical datasets** tailored for AI research needs

✅ Provide certified and benchmarked **radiologists** for annotation and quality assurance

✅ Offer advanced, browser-based annotation tools for all kinds of medical images—radiology, pathology, histopathology, including X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, etc

✅ Use **AI assistance** to make annotators **10x faster**

✅ Enable customizable clinical workflows with multi-stage reviews & annotations

✅ Ensure **FDA-Ready** annotation versioning, consensus checks, and full audit trails

✅ Track annotator performance in cost, time, and **accuracy** - all built in

We’re **Georges and Mathieu — co-founders of Novoflow**.

Novoflow’s multilingual voice agent answers every inbound & outbound call, schedules directly inside any EHR (Epic, Athena, Medent—even 1990s HL7 feeds), and slashes no-shows. Clinics can reclaim **up to $50k/month** on average in missed revenue without hiring another receptionist.

https://youtu.be/LQA-QeiY_F4

### **❌ The Problem**

The old reception model is breaking. Outsourced call centers, dead-end IVRs, and half-integrated schedulers still miss 42% of patient calls. Each unbooked physician hour stacks into a $50,000 monthly loss in revenue per average independent clinic. Medical practices are stuck because decade-old and proprietary EHRs can’t accept real-time integrations from next-gen solutions.

### **🏥 Our Solution**

**Full-stack AI receptionist**

1. **24 / 7 voice AI** greets patients in 25+ languages, verifies insurance, and classifies intent in real-time.
2. **Universal EHR plumbing** writes, reschedules, or cancels appointments natively inside any system.
3. **One-hour go-live**: point our SIP trunk at the clinic’s number—no new phones, no code.
4. **Dashboard & KPIs**: abandonment, call-to-appointment conversion, provider utilization, no-show rate.

launches.tagline: Adentris helps hospitals avoid denials, audits, and fines by catching and fixing documentation errors in real time.
launches.body:
Hi! We’re [Dmitry](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dmitrykarpov/), [Sergey](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yudovskiy/), and [Alex](https://www.linkedin.com/in/odinalex/) — co-founders of [Adentris](https://www.adentris.com/).

**TL;DR:**

Every year, **250 million insurance claims — worth billions of dollars — are denied due to documentation errors**. Many are never recovered. We connect directly to hospital EHRs, monitor clinical staff activity logs in real time, and use AI agents to detect and fix compliance issues before they become risks. **Since the beginning of YC, we’ve reached $54k ARR** and have a growing number of commercial pilots with hospitals and clinics across the U.S. and PoCs with healthcare enterprises.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PrcEY8WgmSk

**Problem:**

One small documentation mistake — like recording a medication time incorrectly — can destroy a family’s finances.

These errors are often made by exhausted clinicians after 12-hour shifts and are caught by automated insurance systems that instantly deny the claim.

**Hospitals don’t discover the problem until it's too late** — after the claim is denied, the audit triggered, or the reputation damaged.

Documentation errors are the invisible threat in modern healthcare. They’re not caused by negligence, but by broken systems: cluttered interfaces, overworked staff, and legacy EHRs that make it easy to click the wrong time, forget a discharge note, or miss a required signature.

**And it’s not just claims** — these small errors lead to failed audits, regulatory fines, delayed discharges, and increased burnout.

Hospitals end up with compliance teams that are reactive — chasing mistakes days or weeks after they happened, often without resolution. The cost isn’t just money. It’s morale, trust, and patient safety.

**Solution:**

Adentris is an AI compliance autopilot that prevents small documentation errors from becoming costly disasters in real time.

We integrate directly with hospital EHRs, monitor clinical activity in real time, and use AI agents to detect and fix issues — like missed discharge notes or wrong medication times — before they trigger claim denials or audits.

When a problem is found, our AI opens a quick conversation with the responsible staff member to confirm and correct it immediately.

**We don’t just alert**. We resolve — and help hospitals run smoother, reduce pressure on teams, and recover revenue that would otherwise be lost.

**What Experts Are Saying:**

"Adentris’s proactive approach is a game‑changer in reducing preventable errors and enabling real‑time accountability in care delivery.”

— [Joel N.H. Stern, PhD](https://www.linkedin.com/in/joel-n-h-stern-07a4342/)\
Professor of Neurology & Molecular Medicine, Zucker School of Medicine at Hofstra/Northwell

**Team:**

[Dmitry](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dmitrykarpov/) (CEO) and [Sergey](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yudovskiy/) (CPO) are second-time YC founders with a strong track record in building B2B enterprise products and go-to-market channels. Sergey comes from a full medical family and has deep personal ties to the problems we're solving in healthcare. [Alex](https://www.linkedin.com/in/odinalex/), (CTO), is a seasoned engineer who built apps used by 25M+ people worldwide and led the development of a full AI agent architecture at his previous multimillion-dollar startup.

**Asks:**

We're actively looking to connect with:

* **Hospital executives and clinic owners** who want to stop losing revenue to preventable compliance errors and team burnout 
* **Providers' CFOs and compliance leaders** who are tired of fighting with clinical staff over documentation and want a system that just works
* **Medical institution advisors and operators** who care about transforming broken workflows
* **Reporters and storytellers** covering the untold side of healthcare — the back office chaos that leads to financial disaster

If you're building, reporting on, or fighting to fix this problem — DM us, email us at [founders@wrkdn.com](mailto:founders@wrkdn.com), or grab 15 minutes with us here [Book a call](https://calendly.com/d/cnpv-x29-nzc/workdone-demo).

Let’s save healthcare from the inside out.

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
Our mission is personal. Each of us watched someone we love slip through the cracks of today’s healthcare system. Peter’s grandfather suffered three preventable ER readmissions before passing—his ruptured aorta went undetected after missed medications and a complete absence of follow-up care. Lukas’s grandmother, who raised him, deteriorated in assisted living—isolated, depressed, and unrecognizable before passing unexpectedly just days before he arrived. Kazuki’s grandfather battled cancer alone in Japan, cut off from family by COVID-era hospital restrictions—reminding us that healing requires more than medicine.

What we experienced is not rare. It’s the reality for tens of millions of older adults. In ERs, nursing homes, and senior communities where we’ve volunteered, we saw the same  patterns: chronic conditions unmanaged, dangerous falls ignored, weeks without human connection, and emergencies that could have been prevented. Aging has become a quiet crisis—fueled by staff shortages, fragmented systems, lack of technology access, and stigma about growing old. 

We’ve invested 600+ hours on the ground working with older adults to deeply understand their’ needs, motivations, and barriers. Our team brings full-stack software, AI/ML, and hardware expertise from Neuralink, Stanford, and NVIDIA, along with operating experience leading major organizations like Zero2One (largest startup group at UIUC), Stanford Founders (1,500+ members), and Covalence (2,000 volunteers across seven universities)—this gives us the tools needed to lead transformation in this space. 

We’re here because we believe older adults deserve independence, dignity, and a healthcare system that truly cares—and we’re building Kaigo Health to make that the new standard.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: Our vision is to transform healthcare into a continuous, preventative, and home-based experience. We start by enabling high touch outpatient care for Medicare providers, supercharging value-based care. This builds consumer trust and a proprietary data layer, and leverages existing provider distribution networks to later phase in more advanced ambient sensing and care delivery technologies (e.g. home robot companions) for 24/7 personal health management - bringing healthcare to the home while hospitals focus on acute care.

launches.body:
# **⏳TL/DR**

Rovi helps employees access high-quality, cost-effective healthcare. We text employees the best in-network options at exactly the right moment, and handle all the complexity.

* Our AI-enabled virtual care treats common conditions quickly over text or video.
* For complex care, our AI agents search across all in-network providers using millions of price and quality data points, then handle scheduling and logistics.
* Employees get rewarded for choosing high-value care through copay reimbursements and waived deductibles.

Launch video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mKNB0CF8_9Y

# **⚠️ The Problem**

Healthcare costs are crushing employers. 2025 is seeing a 9% rate hike, the worst in a decade. A 1,000-person company now faces over $1M in cost increases annually, compounding.

Employers’ only options are to cut benefits or redesign their entire plan. Both take months and frustrate employees.

What if Employers could offset these costs by adding benefits instead?

## **🤨 How is this possible?**

**Price and quality have no correlation in healthcare:**

* The same MRI: $700 at an imaging center vs $2,500 at a hospital. Same network. Same machine.
* The same knee surgery: $7,000 at a surgery center vs $25,000 at a hospital. Same surgeon. Often better outcomes at the surgery center.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94971&key=user_uploads/1230817/7a7a2b27-4c82-410c-9744-82a5af6b1cc2)

**So why does everyone end up with the expensive option?**

1. **Hospitals own the referral pipeline.** They consolidated most primary care practices. When your doctor orders a procedure, their systems automatically directs it to their expensive facilities.
2. **Shopping is impossible.** Prices are hidden, provider directors outdated, quality is opaque. And when you're sick, calling twelve clinics is the last thing you want to do.

**Rovi does the hard work.** Our AI agents analyze terabytes of pricing data, research every provider's quality metrics, and surface options matching each person's preferences for cost, convenience, and availability. Making good healthcare decisions drives down costs for both the employee and the employer.

# **🎯 Impact**

We save employers 10-20% on healthcare spend while improving care outcomes and delivering a health benefit that employees love.

We've already signed contracts to roll out to thousands of employees across multiple employers for the 2025-2026 plan year.

## **🙏🏾 Our ask**

1. **Employers:** We have two final Q1 spots for self-funded employers. Introductions to employer benefits teams, brokers, health plans, and TPAs are welcome. Reach out to [santosh@rovihealth.com](mailto:santosh@rovihealth.com).
2. **Individuals:** [**Join our beta**](https://rovi.health/) to try our AI care concierge. Rovi will find you great in-network doctors whenever you need care. Virtual care coming soon.

## **👬🏾 Our team**

We're brothers on a mission to build AI-native health insurance that members love.

**Santosh** was previously building Cedar's affordability products, scaling to millions in ARR by closing enterprise deals with the country's largest hospital systems. Before that, he led a 30-person GTM & Customer Success team at AngelList. He’s also a licensed health insurance broker.

**Tarun** built foundational AI models to predict extreme weather events at UChicago, where he earned a Master's in AI and high-performance computing. He has a B.S. in biology from Cornell, and is obsessed with using AI to solve healthcare's messiest data problems.

_TL;DR:_ We built AI voice agents that automate insurance calls for healthcare billing teams. Fine-tuned on a dataset of over 1.2M call transcripts, our voice agents can handle insurance calls regarding claim-status inquiries, A/R recovery, and appeals follow-up.

Every week, U.S. healthcare billing teams make tens of millions of calls to insurance companies to get claims paid.\
Each one averages **25 minutes**. That’s how hospitals unlock part of the **$260B in denied or delayed payments** every year.

But there’s a bottleneck:

* Reps can only handle a few calls per hour.
* Staffing is expensive and hard to scale.
* Delays cost millions in unrecovered revenue.

Meanwhile, every new hospital system or insurer integration compounds the complexity.

### **💡 The Solution**

LunaBill’s **AI voice callers** automate those phone conversations end-to-end.

Our voice agents:

* Handle **claim status checks, appeals follow-ups, and reprocessing calls** automatically.
* **Connect to any billing software** and dial claims that need to be worked.
* Run up to **100 concurrent agents** per client, like having a 100-person call center on demand.
* Deliver post-call summaries with the to-do steps, integrated directly into workflows.

They’re **fine-tuned on 1.2M+ real call transcripts**, understand payer logic, and sound completely natural.\
🎧 [Listen](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1jxi7GRUV4h1YDX8XkEYQdFzepboOQLq8/view?usp=sharing) to a real AI insurance call, see if you can guess who’s human.

### **⚡ Our Progress**

To date, LunaBill has automated **60,000+ insurance calls**, saving billing teams over **20,000 hours** and recovering **$30M+** in payments that would otherwise be lost.

Billers now can complete 300+ claim follow-ups per day — up from about 25/day before LunaBill, a \~12x productivity improvement.

LunaBill has partnered with **top healthcare systems** and **three of the biggest enterprise billing companies** across the country.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95408&key=user_uploads/2978935/1f560e14-55c0-4cf7-be59-68fda8d58eb1)

launches.title: Illume Labs - Your 24/7 personalized health companion
launches.tagline: Illume is a 24/7 personal health companion that connects your wearables, nutrition, workouts, and lab results to give you personalized, actionable insights over text.
launches.body:
**Hey everyone 👋!** We’re [Pari](https://www.linkedin.com/in/paridhilatawa/), [Frank](https://www.linkedin.com/in/frank-lee-/), and [Jin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jinwong01/), co-founders of Illume. 

**TL;DR:** Illume is a 24/7 personal health companion that connects your wearables, nutrition, workouts, and lab results to give you personalized, actionable insights over text. 

**Join our private beta waitlist: [www.illumelabs.ai](http://www.illumelabs.ai). \
Watch Our [Launch Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bsfFOzB0Nho):**

**Problem:** 

Health data is more abundant than ever, but it remains scattered. Nearly six in ten U.S. adults own a wearable or connected health device, and nearly one in three used an AI chatbot for health questions. People are generating more health data than ever and actively looking for help understanding it, but their data and guidance still live in separate places. 

We saw this firsthand as family members struggled to piece together glucose readings for diabetes and blood tests for cardiovascular risk, all while juggling a pile of fitness, nutrition, and health-tracking apps that never talked to each other. 

People increasingly turn to ChatGPT or Claude for answers, but without continuous context to their health, the advice is often generic, incomplete, and difficult to track over time.

**Our solution:** 

Illume creates one home for your health and gives you a personal health companion you can text. 

Today, you can: 

* Connect your wearable and automatically sync sleep, activity, and recovery data 
* Text Illume photos of your meals to log and understand your nutrition 
* Record workouts and track your training 
* Upload bloodwork and lab results 
* Ask questions about your health using the context of your own data 
* Receive proactive insights about what changed, what it might mean, and what to do next

For example, you can ask: 

* “Why am I so exhausted today? Make me a dashboard of all the relevant metrics!” 
* “How has eating late affected my sleep?”
* “Am I recovering well enough to train? Run a regression!”
* “What should I focus on before my next blood test?”

Illume connects patterns across your data that individual platforms can’t see, giving you a more complete picture of your health instead of another isolated score or dashboard. 

You can text your Illume agent for quick answers or use the platform to explore your data, trends, and history in greater depth.

**Our mission**

Our long-term vision is to make healthcare more proactive, continuous, and personalized. 

By combining continuous biometrics with nutrition, training, blood panels, and eventually genetic risk, Illume could help surface meaningful changes earlier and help people understand their susceptibility to conditions such as cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and Alzheimer’s. 

We want to help people move from asking, “What happened?” to understanding what may be changing and what they can do about it. 

**Who’s it for:** Illume is initially designed for people who are proactive about their health and longevity- especially lifters, biohackers, and anyone already using wearables, blood panels, CGMs, nutrition trackers, or genetic testing.  

**Who we are:** We’re three MIT graduates who met in freshman year! 

[Pari Latawa](https://www.linkedin.com/in/paridhilatawa/): MIT BS & MEng in CS + Molecular Biology. Previously conducted research at the Broad Institute, Eli Lilly, & MD Anderson. Founded EasyComm to build tools for children with Down Syndrome, and SparkED, a health-literacy nonprofit.

[Frank Lee](https://www.linkedin.com/in/frank-lee-/): MIT BS in Computer Science and Mathematics. Conducted RLAIF research for language models at MIT CSAIL and previously built agent systems at Windsurf.

[Jin Wong](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jinwong01/): MIT BS in Business Analytics. Previously conducted research at the MIT Media Lab and deployed coding agents at Windsurf. 

**Our ask:** 

**Join the private beta waitlist at [www.illumelabs.ai](http://www.illumelabs.ai).** We’ll invite an initial group of founding members to receive early access and help shape the product. 

**If you want to chat or can intro us** to someone in training, sports, longevity, and/or biohacking, email us at [founders@illumelabs.ai](mailto:founders@illumelabs.ai). We’d love to stop by, chat, and show you how Illume works!
